title: FIRM: Federated In-client Regularized Multi-objective Alignment for Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mathematical optimization and communication efficiency of a federated learning algorithm (FIRM) for LLM alignment. While it uses human values (helpfulness and harmlessness) as reward signals and includes qualitative examples of responses to a safety-critical prompt, the core contribution is algorithmic and theoretical rather than an evaluation or benchmark of religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
